title: Shops II: Painter (Shop + Decor), Dye Trader (dyes, Dye Vat), Party Girl, Tavernkeep (Defender Medals)
player_outcome: The Painter has a separate Decor tab with paintings to hang, the Dye Trader sells dyes and a Dye Vat, the Party Girl sells confetti and party gear, and the Tavernkeep trades Defender Medals (dropped by the Old One's Army) for an Eternia Crystal Stand, Ale and more.
design: Painter: existing paints and tools in tab 'shop'; about 8 new paintings (wall-anchored tile objects, a new 'painting' generator in furniture.py drawing a framed procedural canvas) in tab 'decor'.

Dye Trader: dye_vat (station tile object) and 10 basic dyes (silver/brown/black/red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple/pink_dye, category dye). Dyes satisfy the Dye Trader's 'hasItem category dye' arrival. Visual dyeing waits for the equipment phase's dye slots; the tooltip says 'Dye'.
Party Girl: confetti (thrown friendly particle projectile), party_hat (vanity), confetti_gun (ranged, confetti projectile), bubble_machine (decor tile object with a pooled bubble particle).

Tavernkeep: defender_medal (currency item; add to the old_ones_army loot table), eternia_crystal (existing), eternia_crystal_stand (tile object; if ObjectInteraction's Activate plus the startEvent behavior cannot start old_ones_army from the stand, keep it decor and let the crystal item start the event), ale (consumable food giving buff 'tipsy': melee crit up, defense down). Prices in medals via ShopEntry.currency.
Assets through build_all --only, reference concepts in items_town.py, manifest regenerated.
files_modify: tools/blender/bgen/furniture.py — painting generator (keep ≤ 400 lines; put it in a new module if needed)
files_add: data/items/town_shop_decor.json — paintings, dyes, party items, tavern items
data_changes: about 25 new items/objects; buff tipsy; defender_medal drop
tests: TownServicesTests.TavernkeepSellsForMedals: 10 medals buy an ale; coins are untouched
TownArrivalRulesTests.DyeTraderNeedsDye now uses a real dye item
Smoke town.cmds: 'town summon painter 2 0 -3' / 'ui talk painter' / 'ui shop decor' / 'ui close'
verification: validate, manifest --check, gen_reference --check, build_all --check, dotnet test, smoke PASS
In game: hang a bought painting on a wall
risks: Dyes without dye slots are cosmetic-only for now (depends on the equipment phase); say so in the PR.
Wall-anchored objects depend on TileAnchor.Wall support; verify with a placement test.
